en: Black‑and‑white image of a wooden villa or lodge on a hillside edge of a dense coniferous forest. The house has steep gabled roofs, dormer windows, log‑cabin style walls, and a large covered veranda supported by posts on a stone base. A flagpole in front flies a light–over–dark two‑stripe flag. Terraced paths and stairways lead up the slope, with small trees or shrubs planted along the way. Two people in early‑20th‑century clothing stand on the path in the foreground. The overall style suggests a rural or mountain retreat. No printed captions or inscriptions are visible.
